raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation Migrate the Ascend NPU DeepSeek-V4-Flash FP8 4P GPQA test from EAGLE to DSPARK speculative decoding, add a DSPARK acceptance-rate throughput test for the 950 (A5) environment, and load the extra custom ops that DSPARK requires on A5 from the shared NPU e2e launcher. ## Modifications ### 1. Enable DSPARK runtime environment (`python/sglang/test/ascend/e2e/run_npu_testcase.sh`) Add three environment variables required to enable DSPARK for DeepSeek-V4 in the 950 environment: - `SGLANG_DSPARK_A5_EXTRA_OPS_SO` — path to the custom ops shared library (`/usr/local/Ascend/extra-ops/vllm_ascend_C.cpython-312-x86_64-linux-gnu.so`). - `ASCEND_CUSTOM_OPP_PATH` — prepend the custom_transformer vendor path (`/usr/local/Ascend/extra-ops/vendors/custom_transformer/`). - `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` — prepend the custom_transformer `op_api/lib` path. ### 2. Model path and acceptance-rate assertion (`python/sglang/test/ascend/e2e/test_npu_performance_utils.py`) - Change `DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_DEFAULT_MODEL_PATH` from `.../DeepSeek-V4-Flash` to `.../DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731`. - In `assert_metrics`, change the speculative acceptance-rate assertion from `assertGreaterEqual` to `assertGreater`, so `accept_length / --speculative-num-draft-tokens` must be strictly greater than the configured baseline. Both test cases that set `accept_rate` (the new `TestNPUDeepSeekV4FlashDSPARK` below and the existing `test_npu_deepseek_v4_flash_w8a8_8p_in8k_out1k_50ms.py`) now require `> 0.5` instead of `>= 0.5`. ### 3. Migrate FP8 4P GPQA test to DSPARK and add a DSPARK performance test (`test/registered/npu/accuracy/deepseek_v4_flash/test_npu_deepseek_v4_flash_fp8_4p_gpqa_a5.py`) - Imports: move `BENCHMARK_TOOL_DEFAULT` from the `test_npu_accuracy_utils` import to the `test_npu_performance_utils` import (its home), and add `EVALSCOPE` (from `test_npu_accuracy_utils`) and `TestNpuPerformanceTestCaseBase`. - On `TestNPUDeepSeekV4FlashFP84PGPQA`, set `benchmark_tool = EVALSCOPE` explicitly (was `BENCHMARK_TOOL_DEFAULT`; functionally identical since that default is `EVALSCOPE`). Class attributes `accuracy = 0.874`, `datasets = ["gpqa_diamond"]`, `few_shot_num = 0`, generation config, `timeout = 6000` are unchanged. - Environment variables: - Replace `HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024` with `DEEPEP_HCCL_BUFFSIZE=2560`. - Replace the commented-out `DEEPEP_HYBRID_DEPLOYMENT` with `SGLANG_DEEPEP_NUM_MAX_DISPATCH_TOKENS_PER_RANK=256`. - Replace `SGLANG_PROFILE_WITH_STACK=False` with `ASCEND_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1`. - Add DSPARK env vars: `SGLANG_RAGGED_VERIFY_MODE=static`, `SGLANG_DSPARK_FAST_KERNEL=0`, `SGLANG_DSPARK_FAST_SAMPLING=0`. - `other_args`: - Raise `--mem-fraction-static` from `0.72` to `0.73`. - Reduce `--max-running-requests` from `64` to `32`. - Trim `--cuda-graph-bs-decode` from `1 2 4 8 10 16` to `1 2 4`. - Replace `--attn-dp-size 4` with `--enable-dp-attention` and `--dp-size 4`. - Replace the EAGLE speculative config with DSPARK: - Remove `--speculative-algorithm EAGLE`, `--speculative-num-steps 2`, `--speculative-eagle-topk 1`, `--speculative-num-draft-tokens 3`. - Add `--speculative-algorithm DSPARK`, `--speculative-draft-model-path` (same checkpoint as the target model), `--speculative-draft-model-quantization fp8`, `--speculative-draft-attention-backend ascend`, `--speculative-num-draft-tokens 6`, `--speculative-dspark-block-size 5`. - Move `--quantization fp8` to the end of the arg list, after `--moe-a2a-backend deepep` / `--deepep-mode auto`. - Update the class/method docstrings from EAGLE to DSPARK. - Add a new performance test class `TestNPUDeepSeekV4FlashDSPARK` (`TestNpuPerformanceTestCaseBase`) reusing the same `other_args`/`envs`, with `benchmark_tool = BENCHMARK_TOOL_DEFAULT` (benchserving): - `dataset_name = "random"`, `input_len = 8000`, `output_len = 1000`, `num_prompts = 160`, `max_concurrency = 160`, `random_range_ratio = 1`, `warmup_requests = 32`, `request_rate = float("inf")`, `max_attempts = 3`. - `accept_rate = 0.5` (acceptance rate strictly greater than 0.5, per the tightened assertion in section 2). - `test_npu_deepseek_v4_flash_fp8_4p_dspark` runs `run_throughput()`. ## Accuracy Tests Based on the image: [swr.cn-southwest-2.myhuaweicloud.com/base_image/dockerhub/lmsysorg/sglang:cann9.1.0-950-B103](https://swr.cn-southwest-2.myhuaweicloud.com/base_image/dockerhub/lmsysorg/sglang:cann9.1.0-950-B103), the precision meets the standard. ## Speed Tests and Profiling Based on the image: [swr.cn-southwest-2.myhuaweicloud.com/base_image/dockerhub/lmsysorg/sglang:cann9.1.0-950-B103](https://swr.cn-southwest-2.myhuaweicloud.com/base_image/dockerhub/lmsysorg/sglang:cann9.1.0-950-B103), the acceptance rate meets the standard. ## Checklist - [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). - [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). - [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). - [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). - [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance). ## Review and Merge Process 1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process). 2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers. 3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so. - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci` 4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR. --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :x: [Run #41184706912](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41184706912) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #41184706826](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41184706826) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :x: [Run #41184706815](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41184706815) > [!TIP] > Base CI only covers the core cases, and its workload may not exercise your change. Use `/rerun-test` to run the tests your change touches, or copy this prompt for an agent: > > ```text > Find the registered tests this PR affects and run them with /rerun-test, following https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.agents/skills/rerun-test/SKILL.md > ```

detail.body: ## Motivation Migrate the Ascend NPU DeepSeek-V4-Flash FP8 4P GPQA test from EAGLE to DSPARK speculative decoding, add a DSPARK acceptance-rate throughput test for the 950 (A5) environment, and load the extra custom ops that DSPARK requires on A5 from the shared NPU e2e launcher. ## Modifications ### 1. Enable DSPARK runtime environment (`python/sglang/test/ascend/e2e/run_npu_testcase.sh`) Add three environment variables required to enable DSPARK for DeepSeek-V4 in the 950 environment: - `SGLANG_DSPARK_A5_EXTRA_OPS_SO` — path to the custom ops shared library (`/usr/local/Ascend/extra-ops/vllm_ascend_C.cpython-312-x86_64-linux-gnu.so`). - `ASCEND_CUSTOM_OPP_PATH` — prepend the custom_transformer vendor path (`/usr/local/Ascend/extra-ops/vendors/custom_transformer/`). - `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` — prepend the custom_transformer `op_api/lib` path. ### 2. Model path and acceptance-rate assertion (`python/sglang/test/ascend/e2e/test_npu_performance_utils.py`) - Change `DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_DEFAULT_MODEL_PATH` from `.../DeepSeek-V4-Flash` to `.../DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731`. - In `assert_metrics`, change the speculative acceptance-rate assertion from `assertGreaterEqual` to `assertGreater`, so `accept_length / --speculative-num-draft-tokens` must be strictly greater than the configured baseline. Both test cases that set `accept_rate` (the new `TestNPUDeepSeekV4FlashDSPARK` below and the existing `test_npu_deepseek_v4_flash_w8a8_8p_in8k_out1k_50ms.py`) now require `> 0.5` instead of `>= 0.5`. ### 3. Migrate FP8 4P GPQA test to DSPARK and add a DSPARK performance test (`test/registered/npu/accuracy/deepseek_v4_flash/test_npu_deepseek_v4_flash_fp8_4p_gpqa_a5.py`) - Imports: move `BENCHMARK_TOOL_DEFAULT` from the `test_npu_accuracy_utils` import to the `test_npu_performance_utils` import (its home), and add `EVALSCOPE` (from `test_npu_accuracy_utils`) and `TestNpuPerformanceTestCaseBase`. - On `TestNPUDeepSeekV4FlashFP84PGPQA`, set `benchmark_tool = EVALSCOPE` explicitly (was `BENCHMARK_TOOL_DEFAULT`; functionally identical since that default is `EVALSCOPE`). Class attributes `accuracy = 0.874`, `datasets = ["gpqa_diamond"]`, `few_shot_num = 0`, generation config, `timeout = 6000` are unchanged. - Environment variables: - Replace `HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024` with `DEEPEP_HCCL_BUFFSIZE=2560`. - Replace the commented-out `DEEPEP_HYBRID_DEPLOYMENT` with `SGLANG_DEEPEP_NUM_MAX_DISPATCH_TOKENS_PER_RANK=256`. - Replace `SGLANG_PROFILE_WITH_STACK=False` with `ASCEND_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1`. - Add DSPARK env vars: `SGLANG_RAGGED_VERIFY_MODE=static`, `SGLANG_DSPARK_FAST_KERNEL=0`, `SGLANG_DSPARK_FAST_SAMPLING=0`. - `other_args`: - Raise `--mem-fraction-static` from `0.72` to `0.73`. - Reduce `--max-running-requests` from `64` to `32`. - Trim `--cuda-graph-bs-decode` from `1 2 4 8 10 16` to `1 2 4`. - Replace `--attn-dp-size 4` with `--enable-dp-attention` and `--dp-size 4`. - Replace the EAGLE speculative config with DSPARK: - Remove `--speculative-algorithm EAGLE`, `--speculative-num-steps 2`, `--speculative-eagle-topk 1`, `--speculative-num-draft-tokens 3`. - Add `--speculative-algorithm DSPARK`, `--speculative-draft-model-path` (same checkpoint as the target model), `--speculative-draft-model-quantization fp8`, `--speculative-draft-attention-backend ascend`, `--speculative-num-draft-tokens 6`, `--speculative-dspark-block-size 5`. - Move `--quantization fp8` to the end of the arg list, after `--moe-a2a-backend deepep` / `--deepep-mode auto`. - Update the class/method docstrings from EAGLE to DSPARK. - Add a new performance test class `TestNPUDeepSeekV4FlashDSPARK` (`TestNpuPerformanceTestCaseBase`) reusing the same `other_args`/`envs`, with `benchmark_tool = BENCHMARK_TOOL_DEFAULT` (benchserving): - `dataset_name = "random"`, `input_len = 8000`, `output_len = 1000`, `num_prompts = 160`, `max_concurrency = 160`, `random_range_ratio = 1`, `warmup_requests = 32`, `request_rate = float("inf")`, `max_attempts = 3`. - `accept_rate = 0.5` (acceptance rate strictly greater than 0.5, per the tightened assertion in section 2). - `test_npu_deepseek_v4_flash_fp8_4p_dspark` runs `run_throughput()`. ## Accuracy Tests Based on the image: [swr.cn-southwest-2.myhuaweicloud.com/base_image/dockerhub/lmsysorg/sglang:cann9.1.0-950-B103](https://swr.cn-southwest-2.myhuaweicloud.com/base_image/dockerhub/lmsysorg/sglang:cann9.1.0-950-B103), the precision meets the standard. ## Speed Tests and Profiling Based on the image: [swr.cn-southwest-2.myhuaweicloud.com/base_image/dockerhub/lmsysorg/sglang:cann9.1.0-950-B103](https://swr.cn-southwest-2.myhuaweicloud.com/base_image/dockerhub/lmsysorg/sglang:cann9.1.0-950-B103), the acceptance rate meets the standard. ## Checklist - Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so. - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci` 4.
